thought.text:
## Root Cause Found

`resolveCategoryIds(undefined)` is called when `raw.categories` is undefined (Kulturhuset outputs `category` singular).

reasoning_content:
Found it! Line 300: `if (slugs.length === 0) return [];`

When `raw.categories` is undefined (because Kulturhuset outputs `category` not `categories`), `resolveCategoryIds(undefined)` is called. Inside `resolveCategoryIds`, `slugs` is undefined, so `slugs.length` throws the error.

The fix is to either:
1. Change the normalizer to handle undefined: `if (!slugs || slugs.length === 0) return [];`
2. Change the Kulturhuset scraper to output `categories` array instead of `category`

Option 1 is safer since other sources might have the same issue. Let me fix the normalizer.

  if (!slugs || slugs.length === 0) return [];
